def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    remaining = bins - item
    return np.where(remaining >= 0, 1.0 / (1.0 + remaining), -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem_cap = bins - item
    fits = rem_cap >= 0
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    if not np.any(fits):
        return scores
    is_empty = (bins == 1.0) & fits
    if np.any(is_empty):
        first_empty_idx = np.argmax(is_empty)
        scores[first_empty_idx] = -1000.0
        active_fits = fits & ~is_empty
        if np.any(active_fits):
            scores[active_fits] = 1.0 / (rem_cap[active_fits] + 1e-7)
    else:
        scores[fits] = 1.0 / (rem_cap[fits] + 1e-7)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    tightness = 1.0 / (rem[valid] + 1e-5)
    penalty = np.where(rem[valid] < 0.1, 2.0, 0.0)
    scores[valid] = tightness - penalty
    empty_mask = (bins == 1.0)
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.where(empty_mask)[0][0]
        if not valid[first_empty] or rem[first_empty] > 0.5:
            scores[first_empty] = -10.0
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if np.any(valid):
        scores[valid] = 1.0 / (rem[valid] + 1e-7)
    empty_mask = (bins == 1.0) & (bins >= item)
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        if not np.any(valid & (bins < 1.0)):
            scores[first_empty] = np.max(scores[valid]) + 1.0 if np.any(valid) else 0.0
        else:
            scores[first_empty] = -np.inf
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.where(rem >= 0, 1.0 / (1.0 + rem), -np.inf)
    if np.any(rem >= 0):
        empty_mask = (bins == 1.0) | (bins == np.max(bins))
        max_cap = np.max(bins)
        scores = np.where((bins == max_cap) & (~np.any(bins > max_cap - 1e-9)), -10.0, scores)
    return scores
